blockers.evidence: acquisition-status.json: An Innovatrics Business Development representative explicitly stated that Innovatrics does not participate in academic or research-only evaluations and does not provide SDK licences for non-commercial benchmarking.
blockers.why_this_blocks_algorithm_5: Every remaining gate is a question about a delivered package — its identity, its runtime closure, its input route, its profiles, its score API. None of them can be answered about a package nobody holds, and answering them from a support article would be publishing a benchmark route this project had never opened
blockers.how_this_would_be_lifted: Only the vendor can lift it, by supplying a package for this target under terms this project can accept. It is not lifted by obtaining the package from a mirror, a catalogue site or a reseller: a package whose chain of custody does not run to the vendor is a package nothing can pin
